spans.s: दर (I) m.n. 1. A cave, a cavity; 2. a conch shell.
दर (II) m. Fear, terror, न जातहार्देन न विद्विषादरः Kir.i.33.
दर (III) ind. A little, दरमीलिन्नयना निरीक्षते Bh.V.ii.182, 7.
दार (I) m. A rent, a gap, a hole.
दार (II) m. pl. (though singular in sense) A wife, नवे दारपरिग्रहे Ut.i., एते वयममी दाराः कन्येयं कुलजीवितम् K.S.vi.63, M.i.112.
दर-तिमिर n. the darkness of fear, वदसि यदि किंचिदपि दंतरुचिकौमुदी हरति दरतिमिरमतिघोरम् Git.G.x.
दरण n. Breaking, splitting.
दारण n. Rending, splitting, opening.
दरणि m.f. 1. An eddy; 2. a current.
दरणी f. 1. An eddy; 2. a current.
दरद् f. 1. The heart; 2. terror, fear; 3. a mountain, a precipice.
दरद (I) m. pl. A country bordering on Kāshmīr.
दरद (II) m. Fear, terror.
दरद (III) n. Red lead.
दारद (I) m. 1. quick-silver; 2. the ocean.
दारद (II) m.n. Vermilion.
दरि f. A cave, a cavern, a valley, K.S.i.10, Rt.i.25.
दरि f. A cave, a cavern, a valley, K.S.i.10, Rt.i.25.
दारी f. 1. A cleft; 2. a kind of disease (in medicine).

दरिद्रा vi. 2P (pp. दरिद्रित; pres. दरिद्राति; caus. दरिद्रयति; desid. दिदरिद्रासति, दिदरिद्रिषति) 1. To be poor or needy, e.g. व्यापारांतरमुत्सिज्य वीक्षमाणो वधूमुखम् । यो गृहेष्वेव निद्राति दरिद्राति स दुर्मतिः; 2. to be distressed, दरिद्राति यथा हरिः Bt.v.86; 3. to be sparse, दरिद्रति विपद्द्रुमे कुसुमकांतयस्तारकाः Vikr.Ch.xi.74.
दरिद्र a. (f. द्रा) Poor, needy, distressed, स तु भवतु दरिद्रो यस्य तृष्णा विशाला मनसि च परितुष्टे कोऽर्थवान् को दरिद्रः Bhartr.iii.50.
दरिद्र a. (f. द्रा) Poor, needy, distressed, स तु भवतु दरिद्रो यस्य तृष्णा विशाला मनसि च परितुष्टे कोऽर्थवान् को दरिद्रः Bhartr.iii.50.
दरोदर (I) m. 1. A gamester; 2. a stake at play.
दरोदर (II) n. Gambling, die, dice.
दर्दर m. 1. A mountain; 2. a jar slightly broken.
दर्दरीक m. 1. A frog; 2. a cloud; 3. a kind of musical instrument.
दर्दुर m. 1. A frog, पिबंति सलिलं धाराहता दर्दुराः Mrich.v.; 2. a sort of musical instrument; 3. a cloud; 4. name of a mountain, R.iv.51.
दार्दुर m. A conch shell the valve of which opens to the right.
दर्द्रु(द्रु) m. A kind of leprosy (in medicine).
दर्द्रु(द्रु) m. A kind of leprosy (in medicine).
दर्प m. 1. Pride, arrogance, insolence, Bg.xvi.4; 2. vanity, conceit; 3. sullenness, sulkiness; 4. heat; 5. musk.
दर्प-आध्मात a. puffed up with pride.
दर्प-च्छिद्, -हर a. humbling, humiliating.
दर्प-च्छिद्, -हर a. humbling, humiliating.
दर्पक m. Name of Kāmadeva, the god of love.

दर्पण (II) n. 1. The eye; 2. kindling, inflaming.

दर्भ-अंकुर m. a pointed blade of darbha grass, Sak.ii.

दर्भ-आह्वय m. the munjā grass.
दर्भट n. A private apartment, a retired room.
दर्व m. 1. A demon; 2. injuring, killing.
दार्व a. (f. र्वी) Wooden.
दर्वट m. A village constable, a police officer.
दार्वट n. A council-house.
दर्वरीक m. 1. An epithet of Indra; 2. wind; 3. a kind of musical instrument.
दर्विका f. A ladle, a spoon.

दर्श m. 1. Sight, view, appearance; 2. the day of the new moon (अमावास्या); 3. a sacrificial rite performed on the day of the new moon.
दर्श-प m. a god.
दर्श-यामिनी f. the night of the new moon.
दर्श-विपद् m. the moon.
दर्शक (I) a. (f. शिका) Showing, pointing out, K.S.vi.52.
दर्शक (II) n. 1. A doorkeeper, a warder; 2. a skilful man, one conversant with any art or science.
दर्शक (I) a. (f. शिका) Showing, pointing out, K.S.vi.52.

दर्शन n. 1. Observing, looking, knowing, understanding, R.viii.72; 2. sight, vision, चिंताजडं दर्शनम् Sak.iv., R.iii.41; 3. inspection, examination; 4. the becoming visible; 5. act of showing, exhibition; 6. visiting, a visit; 7. colour, appearance, R.iii.57, Bg.xi.10; 8. a vision, a dream; 9. discernment, judgment, intellect; 10. religious knowledge; 11. virtue, moral merit; 12. a doctrine, a theory prescribed in a system; 13. a system of philosophy; (most of these systems are summarized in the Sarvadarśanasangraha); 14. the eye; 15. a mirror.
दर्शन-ईप्सु a. anxious to see.
दर्शन-पथ m. the range of sight or view.
दर्शन-प्रतिभू m. a bail or surety for appearance.
दर्शनीय a. (f. या) 1. Visible, observable, perceptible; 2. good-looking, handsome, beautiful; 3. to be produced in a court of justice.
दर्शनीय a. (f. या) 1. Visible, observable, perceptible; 2. good-looking, handsome, beautiful; 3. to be produced in a court of justice.
दर्शयितृ m. A warder, an usher.
दर्शित a. (f. ता) 1. Shown, manifested, exhibited, Kir.ii.25; 2. proved; 3. seen, understood.

दारुका f. Wooden figure, a puppet.

दारुण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Hard, rough, (op. to मृदु); 2. cruel-harsh, heart-rending, उपेंद्रवज्रादपि दारुणोऽसि Git.G.iv., M.viii.270; 3. terrible, frightful; 4. agonizing, intense, violent, e.g. हृदयकुसुमशोषी दारुणो दीर्घशोकः.
दारुण (II) m. The sentiment of horror (भयानक).
